parameter_comments.Temp: Probe measurement at a single depth. Methods 'HL series 004165HY' and blank (not recorded) are the same series.
parameter_comments.Chla_probe: In-situ probe chlorophyll at a single depth. Rows with a blank method and rows with method 'HL series Chlorophyll a 007202' are merged into one series: they never share a date and give the same lab/probe ratio (Bled: 1.30 and 1.32), so blank-method single-depth chlorophyll is assumed to come from the HL probe (to be confirmed by ARSO). The probe reads about 25% below the lab method (Chla_lab); the two are not merged.
parameter_comments.Chla_lab: Laboratory analysis (SIST ISO 10260:2001) of a water sample, usually mixed over the depth range given by the depth_top / depth_bottom variables.
parameter_comments.TN: Units taken to be ug/L as N (NO3 <= TN in all samples except detection-limit coded ones); to be confirmed by ARSO.
